question: According to Chart TF-G, around what year did the US Highway Trust Fund have outlays exceeding receipts between the fiscal years 1987-1991?
raw_response:
Looking at Chart TF-G, the Receipts line (solid) and Outlays line (dashed) move close together. The Receipts line dips down toward 1990, where it nearly meets/crosses the Outlays line. At 1990 the dashed Outlays line is roughly at or slightly above the solid Receipts line (Receipts dips to ~15.1, Outlays ~15.3), which is where outlays exceed receipts.

<FINAL_ANSWER>1990</FINAL_ANSWER>
